executed collection on HEAD: 8,962 collected / 25 deselected
executed skip verification: pytest tests/pending/ -q -> 49 skipped in 0.35s
executed vitest suite: 9 files / 52 tests — all passed
targeted source reads of every flagged body before classifying (no verdict from regex alone; three heuristic buckets materially corrected by these reads)

execution_reality.default_pytest_run_ci: 8,962 collected / 25 deselected — CI ubuntu (+Windows platform subset) under pytest.ini -m 'not slow'
execution_reality.pending_directory_gate: 49 — never without RUN_PENDING_TESTS=1 + funded keys (verified skips cleanly)
execution_reality.vitest_frontend: 52 — CI (Node 22 job); executed this audit 52/52 pass

findings.finding: 4 empty stub tests (body = docstring + pass with # TODO) — collected in the 8,962 total but can never fail
findings.evidence: verified at HEAD: bodies are docstring + pass with a # TODO describing the intended assertion; honest stubs, not disguised fakes
findings.production_impact: Anthropic-capability claims (prompt caching, vision ImageBlockParam, structured reflection) have zero executable verification today; the green collected count includes them
findings.recommendation: Write the assertions (3 of 4 are small mock-capture tests) or mark skip(reason='stub — pending funded key') until written. Cross-ref: file 16 section A1.

findings.finding: 1 tautological assertion: assert True  # No deadlock = pass — a no-op; the real check is implicit (a deadlock would hang/timeout)
findings.evidence: sibling test test_subtask_slot_different_epics_independent asserts on the entered list, showing the intended style
findings.production_impact: A regression that keeps concurrency but loses per-epic scoping could pass green
findings.recommendation: Assert the post-condition (len(active_a) == 0 and all 4 completions observed).

findings.finding: 44 intentional no-exception tests (weakest legitimate style): body calls the unit and relies on 'it did not raise' (comments: # must not raise, # no raise)
findings.evidence: not fake — a raise fails the test — but there is no positive verification of the result
findings.production_impact: Low: correctness of returned values is unchecked in these paths
findings.recommendation: Opportunistic strengthening only (add a post-condition where a cheap observable exists, e.g. assert returned (allowed, reason) tuples from the budget checks); no mass rewrite warranted.

findings.finding: 29 interaction-only tests (all checks are mock call assertions: assert_not_called / assert_called_once, no value assertions)
findings.evidence: spot-checks show legit negative-path tests with real preconditions (real repo, real settings objects); asserting 'X was NOT called' is the correct way to test skip/guard behavior
findings.production_impact: Residual risk only: a change making the guard unreachable-but-silent (early return before the not-called point) can still show green
findings.recommendation: Advisory note only — no action required; documented so future audits calibrate.

findings.finding: 39 tests (raw heuristic; documented false-positive class return_value=None) assert against literals injected via their own mocks
findings.evidence: standard boundary-mocking: the test verifies the unit's plumbing (mocked value routed through unchanged), not the mocked component's behavior
findings.production_impact: None by itself; recorded as a pattern so readers calibrate what these tests can and cannot catch
findings.recommendation: No action; pattern documented in report section 3 (T-17-105).

findings.finding: CI-blind execution surface quantified: 25 slow-deselected + 49 pending + playwright e2e (11) + e2e-real (6) never run in CI; CI runs pytest/vitest/mypy strict only
findings.evidence: executed collection/skip/execution measurements this audit; vitest 52/52 executed locally as positive evidence
findings.production_impact: Any reader of the CI badge must discount live LLM behavior, real-network tools, browser journeys, and real-stack E2E — deliberate and documented but a real coverage gap
findings.recommendation: Cross-ref file 16 execution plan; add playwright e2e to CI at minimum (mocked-API specs need no key).

findings.location: mocks that mask broken production paths
findings.finding: Tests that legitimately isolate a lower boundary but are the only reason CI stayed green while the corresponding production path was 100% non-functional: (1) bhaskar flagship — test_bhaskar_tool.py:983-1008 patches run_agent_graph on the module so build_agent_graph -> load_role -> roles/bhaskar_agent.md never executes in any test; 849 lines of bhaskar tests stayed green while every real call failed (ok=false, 0 tokens); (2) pipeline/dispatcher.py kept alive only by its own tests while production routing flows through FleetManager.select(); (3) ~14 test-only production APIs whose only callers are tests (v2 policy checks, sync approval-gate wrappers, s3 delete/list)
findings.evidence: verified in source (all three bhaskar tests at :978, :996, :1013 patch run_agent_graph); cross-ref H-3 / PROD-12-103, PROD-11-101, PROD-11-103
findings.production_impact: Systemic risk class 'green CI + broken feature': no individual test is fake, yet the aggregate gives false confidence on exactly the paths the product uses — this is how H-3 (High) survived a 8,900-test suite
findings.recommendation: Targeted, not a mass rewrite: (a) add contract tests exercising each agent's real graph construction from its declared role_name (would have caught the bhaskar gap); (b) dispatcher + test-only API clusters: delete-with-tests or wire-into-production (PROD-11-101/103 recommendations); (c) convention: prefer mocking the external boundary (LLM client, network, clock) over the project's own composition functions.

verified_clean_summary: assert False failure markers (3): legitimate try/except idiom in test_enhancements_settings_pdf.py:256,269,283

is not None validator tests (heuristic hits): e.g. test_git_merge_hardening.py:68-74, test_ssrf_nat64.py:47 — the validator contract is 'returns error string or None', so is not None IS the precise assertion; of 93 weak-assert heuristic hits the sampled >=12 were all legitimate

Helper-based assertion (37 tests): test_fleet_flags x30 and test_handlers_are_valid x7 — assertions live in shared helpers (_assert_all_flags asserts 8 conditions, verified at test_day2_agent_contracts.py:109-121); scanner false positive (no dot-prefix on helper calls)
No fabricated-value tests: no assert x == x; no hardcoded-expected-equals-own-constant; no empty test classes; 0 real xfail (single grep hit is a string literal)
Skip gates are environmental and honest: docker-absent, browser-absent, win32-only markers, key gates; no unconditional skip() shortcuts on regular tests

Generated-family quality (105 test_batch*/test_audit*/test_gap* files): real behavioral tests with 1-12 asserts per test and real fixtures (real git repos, real settings objects) — materially stronger than typical generated suites

Frontend vitest (executed 52/52): expect-per-test ratios 1.3-4.3 (109 expects); lib/api.test.ts verifies security-relevant header behavior (no Authorization leak on GET/DELETE, X-User-Id preservation); 44 toBeDefined/toBeTruthy/toBeInTheDocument are components of richer assertions, not standalone trivial checks
Playwright e2e (11 tests): intentional mocked-network UI-contract tests via page.route fixtures (real-stack alternative exists separately as e2e-real)
not_found: No fabricated-assertion farm: 0 fabricated-value assertions, 0 assert x == x, 0 real xfail masking
No unconditional skip() shortcuts on regular (non-environmental) tests
scan_limitations: Classification is scan-level with source-read verification for every flagged case, but the buckets are heuristics: 'no-check' != 'no-value' (implicit no-exception semantics); mock-passthrough matcher has a documented None false-positive class
The scan cannot detect semantic weakness that compiles like strength (e.g. asserting an intermediate the unit merely forwarded — T-17-105 class)
test_fleet_flags-style helper assertions are invisible to assert-counting scans by construction (documented so the next audit does not re-flag them)
Frontend scan covered the 9 vitest files + 4 e2e specs + e2e-real spec; no per-test semantic review of every TS assertion beyond samples
